KadiPosStore.title: KadiPosStore
KadiPosStore.description: Shared real-time POS store state synced across connected terminal devices in Firestore collection kadi_pos/store.

products.description: Synced catalog products list with updatedAt timestamps for merge conflict resolution.

sales.description: Synced POS sales orders list merged by order ID.

cash.description: Active shift cash drawer, closed shifts history, and emergency sessions.

customers.description: Synced customers and carnet de credit balances.

creditTransactions.description: Synced customer credit debt and payment ledger entries.

supplierInvoices.description: Synced supplier purchase invoices and debt payments (max 300).

remiseBox.description: Synced Remise Box wallets map (max 100) and history entries array (max 300).

lastUpdated.description: Epoch milliseconds timestamp of latest merged store update.

updatedBy.description: Device ID and cashier identifier of the latest updater.

devices.description: Map keyed by deviceId tracking each connected POS terminal's lastActivity, lastSyncAt, lastUpdatedMs, cashierName, and online state.

ownerUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the store owner.

ownerEmail.description: Verified Google email of the store owner.

allowedEmails.description: Bounded allowlist of verified staff emails authorized to sync with this store.

serverSyncedAt.description: Firestore server timestamp verified against request.time.

InvoiceDriveFile.title: InvoiceDriveFile
InvoiceDriveFile.description: Metadata record stored in Firestore linking a purchase invoice image uploaded to Google Drive with invoice number, vendor name, ICE, date, and amount.

driveFileId.description: Google Drive file ID returned by Drive v3 upload API.

driveFolderId.description: Google Drive folder ID where the invoice image is stored.

fileName.description: Original or generated filename stored in Google Drive.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded invoice file (e.g. image/jpeg, image/png, application/pdf).

webViewLink.description: Google Drive web view link for the uploaded file.

invoiceNumber.description: Supplier invoice number associated with the uploaded image.

vendorName.description: Supplier or vendor name associated with the invoice.

vendorIce.description: Optional 15-digit Moroccan ICE tax identifier of the vendor.

totalAmount.description: Total TTC amount on the invoice.

notes.description: Optional notes attached to the archived invoice file.

ownerUid.description: Authenticated Firebase UID of the merchant who uploaded the invoice.

ownerEmail.description: Verified Google email of the merchant who uploaded the invoice.

InvoiceScan.title: InvoiceScan
InvoiceScan.description: Scanned purchase invoice record stored in Firestore collection invoice_scans linking the Google Drive File ID with form metadata (invoice number, vendor name, date) and the user's account.

driveFileId.description: Google Drive file ID returned upon successful image upload.

driveFolderId.description: Google Drive folder ID where the scanned invoice image is stored.

mimeType.description: MIME type of the uploaded invoice image or PDF.

webViewLink.description: Google Drive web view link for the uploaded file.

invoiceNumber.description: Invoice number entered or scanned in the form.

vendorName.description: Vendor or supplier name entered or scanned in the form.

vendorIce.description: Optional Moroccan ICE identifier for the vendor.

notes.description: Optional notes associated with the invoice scan.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID linking this invoice scan to the user's account.

userEmail.description: Verified Google account email of the user who uploaded the invoice.

/kadi_pos/{docId}.description: Per-merchant isolated store synchronization documents (store_<uid>) or shared store document (store) storing products, sales, cash drawer state, customers, credit ledger, categories, lastUpdated, updatedBy, and connected devices registry.

/kadi_pos_invoice_files/{fileId}.description: Legacy metadata records linking scanned purchase invoice files uploaded to Google Drive with invoice number, vendor name, ICE, date, and total amount.

/invoice_scans/{scanId}.description: Scanned purchase invoice metadata linking the returned Google Drive File ID with invoice number, vendor name, date, and the authenticated user's account.
